data.name: IBA Boxing game
data.detailed_description:
IBA Boxing Game is the official boxing metaverse where you don't just fight in the ring — you live in the world of boxing. Explore cities, meet real players, train, level up your fighter, and step into the ring when you're ready.

From your very first minutes, you land on the streets of New York — a living open city with up to 50 players sharing the same space at once. The city is full of points of interest to discover, training gyms to enter, and real players to meet and challenge. Within your first ten minutes you choose one of ten real world boxing champions, earn your first coins at the gym, upgrade your gear, and throw down a challenge to a live opponent right on the street. Every action moves you forward — and you feel it from the start.

Training is not just an animation. Running, hitting the heavy bag, and doing pull-ups in the gyms of each city genuinely upgrades your fighter's stats and earns you virtual currency. Spend it on loot boxes containing nine different equipment items — gloves, shorts, boxing shoes and more. Each item directly affects your fighter's performance. Gloves change your punch power and speed, shoes improve your mobility, shorts boost your stamina. The right loadout gives you a real edge in the ring, not just a different look.

The combat system in IBA Boxing Game is fundamentally different from other boxing games. Fighters don't move around the ring — they stand face to face, and every exchange is built on timing, decision-making, and reading your opponent. Each round you choose whether to attack the head or body, throw up a block, or go for a counter. Every fighter has a health bar and a stamina bar, and both matter. Land enough hits to the head and the critical damage builds up fast, sending your opponent to the canvas. Three knockdowns and the fight is over. The third one counts as a knockout — just like in real boxing. On top of that, each of the ten champions comes with a unique set of combinations built around their real fighting technique. Roy Jones Jr., Ben Whittaker, and Albert Batyrgaziyev all fight differently — and you feel it in every exchange.

As you progress, new cities unlock. After New York comes Havana, soaked in the tradition of the Cuban boxing school, one of the most respected in the history of the sport. Then Moscow, with its own distinct boxing culture and legacy. Each city brings new gyms, new rings, new points of interest, and new live players to face. You earn currency win or lose, so your progress never stops. The best fighters climb the global leaderboards and the city champion rankings.

IBA Boxing Game is the only boxing game built around real world champions whose actual techniques and fighting styles are the foundation of gameplay, not just the packaging. This is not a boxing-themed game. This is boxing, turned into a world.

data.short_description: Cross-platform multiplayer boxing. Fight online from your phone and PC!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (9th Gen) / Ryzen 1500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (9th Gen) / Ryzen 1700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 570/Intel ARC A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is a boxing simulation centered around realistic competitive matches. The mature content is limited to the athletic violence typical of a boxing match.

    Violence: Features direct blows to the face and body delivered with boxing gloves.

    Injuries/Blood: Visual depictions of minor injuries such as bruising (синяки) and minor cuts/lacerations (рассечения) on the face and body that occur during the fight.

Violence in the game is strictly confined to the context of a competitive boxing match in the ring.

The game does not feature topics related to sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
